strings: Even with all of r_c0's assurances, m_c is certain that there is something out there, hunting for {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
m_c feels rooted in place while it feels like something large looms in the shadows, hunting specifically for {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.

No matter what m_c's Clanmates say, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/refuse/refuses} to let {PRONOUN/m_c/self} calm down. If {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/drop/drops} {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} guard, that's when danger will strike.
m_c is convinced that something bad will happen, refusing to stop pacing and checking the camp for anything out of place, even a stray leaf seeming to be a threat.
With a loud refusal, m_c insists it's not paranoia. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} just {VERB/m_c/know/knows} that there is a danger out there after the Clan.
m_c keeps checking in on the medicine cat, asking over and over about any signs from StarClan this moon.
